title: Ruby, Sparks and Crackle | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
Ruby meets Sparks and Crackle in a warm adventure about patience, friendship, and growing at your own pace. Some good things hatch only when they are ready.

Book Two of Ruby and the Dragon Bonds. Written with love by Luna, Sunny, and Mommy.

Listen, follow the highlighted words, and enjoy each illustrated page with a soft guitar, piano, and woodwind score. Made for little dreamers and the grown-ups reading beside them.

Read the illustrated book: https://kolatts.github.io/luna-story-time/reader.html?book=ruby-sparks-and-crackle
